message: The other day, I was in the middle of a family outing when my phone decided to take a nap—right as I was trying to find our way back home. Talk about a panic moment! It got me thinking about how important it is to have a backup plan, even for little things like directions. A printed map or a quick list of emergency contacts tucked in my bag could’ve saved the day. Have you ever faced a tech hiccup at just the wrong moment? What’s your go-to backup plan?
